title: PDH/PDL Sweep at the 18:00 & London Opens
excerpt: At the 18:00 ET Asia open and the 02:00 ET London open, how often does NQ sweep the prior day's high or low in the first 3 minutes — and when it does, does it continue or reverse? Descriptive study of the open-sweep behaviour by open and direction (2024–2026 regime).
